sloka: अरणिं तत्र निक्षिप्य मथनं चक्रुरोजसा ।मन्त्रहोमैर्महात्मानः पुत्रहेतोर्निमेस्तदा ।। ७.५७.१८ ॥
transliteration: araṇiṁ tatra nikṣipya mathanaṁ cakrurojasā ।mantrahomairmahātmānaḥ putrahetornimestadā ।। 7.57.18 ॥

translations.english: Then, the great-souled sages, for the sake of a son for Nimi, placed the fire-stick there and performed churning with might and mantra-oblations.
